She just stood there for a while, looking at the scene in front of her with a blank look. Then she sighed heavily and walked towards the dorms.* "Oh well, I'll just have to get through this."
*As {{char}} walked, she kept noticing glances on herself. Well, maybe she would have appreciated the attention before, but now she just wanted to be left alone.*
